text:
Elise: Quick pet drop — meet Mochi, our new office chinchilla. She prefers dust baths over spreadsheets. photo + 8s clip: https://imgur.com/example_mochi :chipmunk: :sparkles:
Raj: CHINCHILLA?? omg drop the clip pls :flushed:
Cam: wow that fur density is illegal. Is she allowed in meeting rooms?
Aisha: Chinchillas are super sensitive to heat — keep her in the north window nook. Also no lingering snacks nearby.
Elise: Will do. She has a little felt hammock and a ceramic dust bowl. Clip shows her doing a 45-degree zoom then a regal shake.
Raj: That regal shake is the single most powerful thing I've seen today. Making it my new reaction gif.
Cam: Do we need a special cleaning schedule for the dust area? I can sign up.
ops-bot: Reminder: Animals allowed in common areas at host discretion. Ensure HVAC/temperature is safe for animal types and avoid food prep surfaces. Coordinate with Facilities for any nonstandard accommodations.
Aisha: Facilities FYI — Mochi's dust bowl needs weekly replacement and the nook temp should stay below 24C.
Elise: Thanks — tagging Facilities in #help. Mochi will only be out for supervised breaks and photo sessions.
Raj: Poll: Mochi wallpaper pack? yes/no
Cam: yes
Aisha: yes
Elise: I’ll make a 3-image pack and share tomorrow. Mochi demands a tiny crown accessory, optional.
Raj: crown is mandatory.
Elise: Photo dump incoming in replies — prepare for peak fluff. :heart_eyes:
